assessor: Anthropic Claude (Opus 5.5), one dependent AI assessor in this interactive session, for the 224 new #78 grouping candidates; the 1689 inherited labels are the unchanged #21 source-reviewed set (OpenAI Codex and Anthropic Claude). No human labels.
evidence_scope: First pass over all 224 new pairs using stored titles, types, descriptions and bulletin/metadata text from the frozen 3,424-document corpus (including targeted passages for 15-24 unemployment and survey/register sources), with the inherited grades of the same document and same-series releases in every query shown for consistency. Live MCP evidence is reserved for the sequential review.
limitations: The new pairs are graded by Anthropic Claude while inherited labels come from the earlier Codex/Claude reviews; none is independent and the assessor implemented series grouping. The assessor saw which system returned each candidate but no scores. No human validation or inter-rater agreement. Pooled recall is not exhaustive corpus recall.

agreement.reason: Single AI assessor; no independent human judge pairs

series_metric: Series-collapsed nDCG@10: within each top ten only the first document of a bulletin series (bulletin and metadata share series_id) keeps its gain; the ideal takes each series' best grade once. repeated_series_slots counts the top-ten slots that repeat an already shown series.
reviewed_assessor: Anthropic Claude (Opus 5.5), the same dependent AI assessor as the first pass, in a sequential source review of the 224 new pairs; inherited labels keep their source-reviewed grades. No human assessors.
reviewed_evidence_scope: All 1913 pairs carried forward; every pooled document was rechecked through 854 live get_tuik_resource responses (6 archived), with 48 live portal replays and bounded table probes. Revisions cite a frozen passage that also occurs in the live response.
reviewed_limitations: The new pairs are graded by Anthropic Claude while inherited labels come from the earlier Codex/Claude reviews; none is independent and the assessor implemented series grouping. The assessor saw which system returned each candidate but no scores. No human validation or inter-rater agreement. Pooled recall is not exhaustive corpus recall.
